instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a module that detects the longest consecutive sequence of 1's in a 16-bit input vector. Output the length of the longest sequence and the starting index of the sequence. If there are multiple longest sequences, output the one with the smallest starting index. 
Hint: You can use a counter to keep track of the length of the current sequence and another counter to keep track of the starting index of the current sequence. When a 0 is detected, compare the length of the current sequence with the length of the longest sequence seen so far and update the output accordingly. Don't forget to reset the counters when a 0 is detected.
